purpose: 在前次全量迁移证据之外，独立记录用户检查暴露的视觉细节和新增项目时序边界修复，不覆盖历史报告。

changes.description: 表单对齐原稿的512px最大宽度/窄屏边距、标题和副标题、字段字体和高度、来源单选、固定页脚左右动作；克隆进度/失败/完成使用相同结果布局与图标、真实progressbar，以及包含标题、项目名和原因的失败播报。

Git接受和完成不自动抢走当前任务，只有打开项目才切换；空项目直接就绪并清旧任务。迟到POST种子不覆盖先到WS/REST终态；重连后的成功REST快照可补回漏掉的终态，并保留请求期间更新的WS投影。凭证入口都携带原项目回程，跳转前关闭弹层；重试受理后选中原项目、清旧任务和弹层、不再次创建项目。名称40个Unicode码点的前后端口径一致。 后续检查发现MCP tools/list名称长度声明随refine丢失，已通过公开serverMutator补回同源maxLength40，由真实MCP发现/调用协议回归验证。
终端标签与活动会话工具共用40px终端栏；工具为28px按钮，画布从栏下直接延伸并使用12px/16px内边距。去掉重复的任务面包屑与菜单；任务菜单由共享顶栏提供。活动会话把工具Portal到共享栏，切会话仍保留PTY和画布实例，工具只操作活动会话。

limits: Reference f-wb-live-01 has a 32px reconnect banner and demonstration Codex output. Connected component story intentionally has no reconnect strip and no simulated xterm text. Compare shared bar and canvas box metrics separately; no whole-page pixel-perfect or ANSI-output claim.
Canvas story decorator now supplies 320px height so the ref-only component is visible instead of its previous collapsed 20px preview. Production canvas sizing remains governed by the task layout.

Current-session callbacks/portal teardown are verified with actual containers and HTTP, scripting only the xterm engine and external socket boundary. Root separately runs the real cross-repository PTY scenario.
matchedComparison.beforeThemeLimitation: Before screenshots were captured before root fixed global Storybook theme propagation. The terminal bar and canvas themselves are black; surrounding preview was light. Keep this actual evidence, do not call it a pixel-identical deep-dark page before/after.

changes.description: 共享阴影与焦点样式以shadow类型明确的Tailwind任意值引用现有设计token；Storybook在iframe documentElement上应用dark/light，使Radix Portal弹层、菜单与主体使用同一主题；默认dark，可从工具栏切换。

projectVisualComparison.method: Real Storybook rendering versus imported static draft; identical Chrome, viewport, DPR1, theme and example data; reduced motion; draft frame chrome removed, component CSS preserved. No pixel-equivalence claim.
projectVisualComparison.limit: 32组捕获时DOM宽高全部匹配、无溢出；原始PNG两侧尺寸也全部匹配。RGB差异统计仅用于诊断，不设置像素等价通过阈值；1440/390四组合不冒充前次三宽度六组合全量重跑。

pixelComparison.method: Decode original PNGs to RGB, without resize, registration, cropping or perceptual filtering. A pixel is changed when max(abs(RGB design - RGB Storybook)) > 12. Different sizes use the top-left aligned union canvas; non-shared pixels always count as changed. Overlay composites the original Storybook raster at 50% alpha over the original design raster. This is a diagnostic statistic, not a pixel-equivalence claim.
pixelComparison.domVsRasterLimit: 01–03的PNG截取在部分组合比DOM高度多1px，原稿与Storybook两侧一致；DOM指标与PNG解码尺寸分别记录，不将519px DOM写成520px DOM。

reasons: 初轮只包含01–06与08，缺少07；28组不是最终32组。
01截图时Storybook play未结束，存在交互状态竞态；即使个别宽高相同也不能作为同状态验收。
05原稿与Storybook示例数据未对齐，进度/时长等文本影响几何；差值不能据此单独归因布局。
